newsitem.title: UK: WestMerchant to lead debut Eurobond for Sverdlovsk.
newsitem.headline: WestMerchant to lead debut Eurobond for Sverdlovsk.

text.p: WestMerchant Bank said on Tuesday it had won the mandate to lead manage the debut Eurobond issue for the region of Sverdlovsk in Russia.
WestMerchant said it would be advising Sverdlovsk with respect to obtaining international credit ratings.
Inkombank is acting as a financial advisor to the region on the transaction.
Sverdlovsk is situated around the Urals city of Yekaterinburg.

In December last year, the region said it planned to issue a three-month Eurobond for up to $20 million in March 1997. It said proceeds from the bond would be used to fund the regional budget and other programmes.
